params.prompt:
Image 1 is the SCENE: a young man sitting in an office chair facing us with his eyes closed, a keyboard along the bottom of the frame, and a wrecked office behind him. Image 2 is a very wide view of the same office in which two small creatures are caught mid-action: a small lavender-and-blue cartoon STAR spinning on the spot with its arms flung out and small sketches flying around it, and a small periwinkle-blue CLOUD creature with a bracket-and-dash face leaping up the front of a black server rack with its arms up. Use Image 2 only for the exact poses of those two creatures.

Add those two creatures to Image 1, frozen in exactly those mid-action poses, as if time had stopped. Keep Image 1 unchanged in every other respect — same camera, same framing, same young man with his eyes closed in the same chair, same keyboard, same fixtures, same wreck, same paper and palette.

THE STAR: standing on the floor in the middle distance behind the man's LEFT shoulder (the right side of the picture as we look at it is the server rack; place the star on the open floor in front of the far wall of taped sketches, a little left of centre), frozen mid-spin — body leaning into the turn, both arms flung straight out sideways, two points streaked into short curved smear arcs, a ring of small curved motion lines at its waist, three small square sketches frozen in the air around it. Small: thigh-high to a grown adult, shorter than the worktable behind it.
THE CLOUD: frozen in the air a little way up the front of the tall black server rack on the RIGHT, in the middle of a leap towards the big screen of code above it — both stubby arms up, body stretched a little taller, a short cluster of speed lines beneath it, its pale bracket-and-dash face tipped up at the screen. Small: a quarter of the rack tall.
Both creatures are three-quarters towards us; neither looks into the camera. Light coloured-pencil wash on both, a soft graphite contact shadow beneath the star.

Hand-drawn animation pencil test: graphite line, cross-hatch shadow, light coloured-pencil wash, paper tooth showing — no flat vector fill, no digital gradients, no painterly rendering, no 3D. Do not add any text.
